content: WhatsApp's inline waveform 'voice message' player only renders for .ogg/Opus-encoded audio; M4A/AAC files shared via ACTION_SEND arrive in the chat as a playable audio/document attachment (tap to play) but WITHOUT the voice-note waveform bubble UI. This is expected default behavior for this project (M4A output), not a bug — matches PROJECT.md's explicit acceptance that m4a arriving as a playable audio file is OK.
